name: Who Sabi?
description: Naija trivia with friends: the API, the web app and the worker (the game app). The admin console is a second app from this repository; see docs/deploy/heroku.md.

WHOSABI_APP.description: Which app this is: game (this one) or admin.

PGSSLMODE.description: Heroku Postgres needs TLS with a certificate Node can't check.

REDIS_TLS_VERIFY.description: Heroku Key-Value Store uses a self-signed certificate.

EVENTS_IN_API.description: The API takes analytics events itself (no ingest app).

JWT_PRIVATE_KEY.description: ES256 private key (PEM) that signs sessions. Make it with: pnpm --filter @whosabi/api keys

PUBLIC_WEB_URL.description: This app's address, e.g. https://whosabi-staging-xxxx.herokuapp.com (duel links use it).

GOOGLE_CLIENT_IDS.description: Google sign-in for players: OAuth client ids, comma-separated. Empty turns it off.

EXPO_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID.description: The web client id for the Google button, built into the web app.

ADMIN_GOOGLE_CLIENT_IDS.description: The admin console's Google OAuth client id, for staff sign-in.
